kroe01.title: Opened With "hey"
kroe01.caption:
You matched, you typed "hey," you hit send. Now what?
Give them something to answer, like a question about their photo.

kroe02.title: The 2 a.m. "u up?"
kroe02.caption:
Is "u up?" at 2 a.m. ever the move?
Send it in daylight with a real plan instead.

kroe03.title: The Six-Paragraph Hello
kroe03.caption:
Six paragraphs before they even said hi?
One line and one question leaves room for them to talk.

kroe04.title: The Cheesy Pickup Line
kroe04.caption:
Pickup lines: cringe or brave?
Corny is fine. Follow it with a real question so they can play along.

kroe05.title: The Four-Minute Voice Note
kroe05.caption:
A four-minute voice note as a first hello?
Keep it short and curious. Ask about something they shared.

kroe06.title: "I Hope This Message Finds You Well"
kroe06.caption:
Opened like a cover letter and wondered why it felt stiff?
A plain "hi" and a fun question works better.

kroe07.title: "You're Gorgeous" (That's It)
kroe07.caption:
"You're gorgeous" and then nothing?
Compliment something they chose, then ask about it.

kroe08.title: Sorry to Bother You
kroe08.caption:
Starting with "sorry to bother you"?
You're not bothering anyone. Lead with something warm and specific.

kroe09.title: Pizza Debate Opener
kroe09.caption:
Is a food debate the perfect first message?
A fun, easy question beats a perfect line every time.

kroe10.title: The Ghost Hypothetical
kroe10.caption:
Would you answer a ghost question from a stranger?
Weird is fine. A playful question opens the door.

kroe11.title: "Dinner Tomorrow, 7 PM"
kroe11.caption:
Matched two seconds ago and already planning dinner?
Excited is cute. Chat a little first, then make the plan.

kroe12.title: "Hi, I Already Love You"
kroe12.caption:
Ever wanted to say "I love you" in the first message?
Big heart, small first step. Start with something kind.

kroe13.title: Hi [NAME]!
kroe13.caption:
Sent the copy-paste opener with the brackets still in?
Write it for them, using something from their profile.

kroe14.title: Correcting Their Bio
kroe14.caption:
Correcting their grammar as a first message?
Lead with what you liked about their bio instead.

kroe15.title: All About Me
kroe15.caption:
Opened with a list of your best qualities?
Make the first question about them.

kroe16.title: "What's Your Deepest Fear?"
kroe16.caption:
"What's your deepest fear?" on day one?
Go deep later. Start with something small and easy to answer.
